legend: Daniel is organizing a football tournament. He has come up with the following tournament format:

In the first several (possibly zero) stages, while the number of teams is even, they split in pairs and play one game for each pair. At each stage the loser of each pair is eliminated (there are no draws). Such stages are held while the number of teams is even.

Eventually there will be an odd number of teams remaining. If there is one team remaining, it will be declared the winner, and the tournament ends. Otherwise each of the remaining teams will play with each other remaining team once in round robin tournament (if there are x teams, there will be ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/633d3cd6417e5c6e9ea549a0e8c5ec3fedb38b92.png) games), and the tournament ends.

For example, if there were 20 teams initially, they would begin by playing 10 games. So, 10 teams would be eliminated, and the remaining 10 would play 5 games. Then the remaining 5 teams would play 10 games in a round robin tournament. In total there would be 10+5+10=25 games.

Daniel has already booked the stadium for n games. Help him to determine how many teams he should invite so that the tournament needs exactly n games. You should print all possible numbers of teams that will yield exactly n games in ascending order, or -1 if there are no such numbers.
input: The first line contains a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1018), the number of games that should be played.
Please, do not use the %lld specifier to read or write 64-bit integers in С++. It is preferred to use the cin, cout streams or the %I64d specifier.
output: Print all possible numbers of invited teams in ascending order, one per line. If exactly n games cannot be played, output one number: -1.

legend.ai: Daniel 正在组织一场足球锦标赛。他设计出了以下赛制：
在最初的若干个阶段中（可能为零个），只要队伍数量为偶数，就将队伍两两分组，每组进行一场比赛。在每个阶段中，每组的失败者都会被淘汰（比赛不会平局）。当队伍数量为偶数时，就会持续进行这样的阶段。
最终，剩余队伍的数量将变为奇数。如果只剩下一支队伍，则它将被宣布为获胜者，锦标赛结束。否则，所有剩余队伍将与其他每支剩余队伍各比赛一次，进行循环赛(如果有 x 支队伍，则会进行 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/633d3cd6417e5c6e9ea549a0e8c5ec3fedb38b92.png) 场比赛)，之后锦标赛结束。
例如，如果最初有 20 支队伍，它们将首先进行 10 场比赛。因此，10 支队伍会被淘汰，剩下的 10 支队伍再进行 5 场比赛。然后，剩下的 5 支队伍将进行 10 场循环赛。总共会进行 10+5+10=25 场比赛。
Daniel 已经为 n 场比赛预订了体育场。请帮助他确定应该邀请多少支队伍，使得锦标赛恰好需要进行 n 场比赛。请按升序输出所有能够恰好进行 n 场比赛的队伍数量；如果不存在这样的数量，则输出 -1。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 10^18），表示需要进行的比赛场数。
请不要在 С++ 中使用 %lld 格式说明符来读写 64 位整数。建议使用 cin、cout 流，或使用 %I64d 格式说明符。

output.ai: 按升序输出所有可能邀请的队伍数量，每行一个。如果无法恰好进行 n 场比赛，则输出一个数：-1。
